The Solution Delivery Leader represents a fundamental shift in how we define delivery excellence. As software moves from a structured SDLC to continuous, AI-powered engineering cycles, quality can no longer be a downstream activity it must be designed, engineered, and continuously validated in real time within the lifecycle.

This role is designed to bridge the gap between client problems and engineering solutions. You will not be measured by execution alone, but by your ability to shape solutions, influence engineering leaders, and bring AI-led innovation to life.

You are the face of technology-driven delivery, helping clients transition from testing services to intelligent, always-on quality engineering ecosystems.

AI-Powered Delivery & Continuous Quality Engineering (40%)

  • Drive measurable business and engineering outcomes

Must have skills :SAP Configure Price & Quote

Good to Have skills :NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary

You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Configure Price & Quote (CPQ) solutions while leveraging AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. This role focuses on enabling efficient quotation processes, intelligent product configuration, accurate pricing, and seamless sales enablement while integrating pre built AI capabilities to uplift cycle times and decision quality??without requiring deep AI system development.
Key Responsibilities
CPQ Functional & Technical Delivery
Configure and enhance SAP CPQ processes including:
oProduct Configuration Rules & Constraints
oPricing Rules, Discounts, and Surcharges
oQuote Generation and Approval Workflows
oGuided Selling & Product Recommendations
oIntegration with CRM, ERP, and eCommerce systems
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oRule writing and validation
oDocumentation (FS/TS/user stories)
oTest case creation for configurations, pricing, and quoting
oError detection and impact assessments
Support full lifecycle:requirements, solution design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, and hypercare.
Ensure seamless synchronization with SAP Sales Cloud, ECC/S4 pricing, and master data frameworks.
AI Assisted Productivity
Apply AI copilots for:
oRequirement analysis and summarization
oPattern detection in pricing or configuration errors
oAutomated generation of configuration and pricing test scenarios
oDrafting of knowledge content, SOPs, and training materials
Integrate pre built AI services such as:
oIntelligent product recommendations based on historical quoting patterns
oAutomated summarization of complex configurations
oAI assisted quote validation and error flagging
oAutomated opportunity scoring or quote prioritization
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce turnaround time for configuration rule failures or integration issues.
Governance, Quality & Collaboration
Ensure CPQ processes comply with pricing governance, discount controls, audit guidelines, and approval frameworks.
Participate in requirement workshops, configuration reviews, pricing governance meetings, and optimization discussions supported by AI-driven insights.
Collaborate with Sales, Pricing, Product Management, CRM, and ERP teams for end to end solution delivery.
Contribute reusable templates, test packs, pricing guidelines, and AI enabled best practices.

Required Skills & Experience
SAP CPQ Expertise
Hands on experience with CPQ configuration including rules engine, pricing logic, quote workflows, and guided selling.
Understanding of CPQ integration with CRM (SAP Sales Cloud, C4C, or CRM legacy) and ERP pricing conditions.
Familiarity with product models, variant configuration concepts, and approval frameworks.
AI Ready Skills
Experience using AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI supported testing accelerators.
Ability to embed pre built AI capabilities into CPQ workflows (not custom LLM/RAG model training).
Understanding of responsible AI usage, especially in pricing and sales decision contexts.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to configuration, pricing, and quoting logic.
Ability to translate sales and product management requirements into accurate CPQ configurations.
Effective communication with business and technical teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI enabled workflows.

Good to Have
SAP CPQ Certification or experience with SAP Sales Cloud (C4C).
Exposure to Variant Configuration (VC/AVC) in S/4HANA.
Experience with eCommerce or CRM platforms.
Familiarity with automated testing tools or rule simulation frameworks.

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate CPQ solutions using AI assisted productivity tools.
Improve quoting accuracy, cycle time, and sales efficiency.
Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, Pricing, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts where deeper AI insights are needed.

Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

Job Title: Cyber Resilience Cloud Security Leader
Management Level: 07 Manager
Location: Bangalore/ Mumbai/ Hyderabad
Must have skills:
Strategic offering/product planning expertise, including market and competitive analysis, data-driven business cases, and value proposition development to shape vision and roadmap.
Strong domain knowledge in cloud security and familiarity with Google Cloud security services (e.g., Google Security Operations/Chronicle SIEM, Mandiant, SCC, SOAR/SecOps; tools such as Wiz), plus working knowledge of Generative AI concepts and Google Cloud AI (e.g., Gemini, Vertex AI, agentic SOC use cases).
Proven ability to define and execute end-to-end go-to-market strategies (packaged offers and launches), including creation of sales, enablement, and marketing assets.
Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed, global environmentcollaborating with cross-functional teams and alliance partners with strong executive communication across regions and time zones.
Entrepreneurial, action-oriented mindset with comfort operating in ambiguitybalancing speed with rigor and driving outcomes independently.
Strong execution discipline to take ideas from concept to release: translating priorities into a deliverable plan, iterating with feedback, and improving based on outcomes and data.
Experience:
12+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, technical marketing, or solution ownership roles, preferably within cloud security domains.
Nice to have:
Relevant Google Cloud certifications are highly desirable.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor''s degree in a technical or business-related field; Master''s degree is a plus.

Job Overview:
Reinvent how organizations operate, innovate, and grow securely in an AI driven world.
Accenture is seeking a security leader to build confidence, resilience, and trust into digital operations. You will define and scale productized security solutions that help organizations manage risk, detect and respond to threats, and strengthen cyber resiliencewithout the complexity and long timelines of traditional large enterprise programs.
In this role, you will lead the strategy and evolution of a portfolio of productized security solutions on Google Cloud, spanning cloud posture management, threat intelligence, SecOps, zero trust, and managed security services. You will help clients shift from reactive security models to proactive, intelligence led cyber resilienceimproving outcomes and accelerating time to value.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive the end to end strategy and roadmap for Cyber Resilience Cloud Security solutions that help organizations protect their digital core, manage risk, and operate securely at scale.
Lead market and client insights across cloud security, SecOps, zero trust, and AI driven security, translating them into differentiated positioning, priority use cases, and roadmap priorities.
Serve as a security thought leader and evangelist, shaping perspectives on cyber resilience, cloud security, and AI enabled defense through client engagements, executive briefings, blogs, webinars, and industry forums.
Develop the go to market (GTM) strategy and assets for Cloud Security offerings, including messaging, value propositions, product and commercial packaging, launch planning, and coordination with sales, marketing, and alliance teams.
Act as a domain SME in cloud security and cyber resilience to support strategic sales pursuits, including opportunity shaping, sales enablement, solution positioning, and proposal development focused on risk reduction and time to value.
Track performance against defined KPIs (e.g., adoption, pipeline influence, time to value, service effectiveness, win rate), using insights to continuously enhance the offering and GTM approach.
Build strong partnerships with Google Cloud and ecosystem partners to align roadmaps, co-innovate AI-driven security capabilities, and accelerate joint GTM motions.

jobDescription:
Project Role : Business Process Architect
Project Role Description : Analyze and design new business processes to create the documentation that guides the implementation of new processes and technologies. Partner with the business to define product requirements and use cases to meet process and functional requirements. Participate in user and task analysis to represent business needs.
Must have skills : SAP FSCM Treasury and Risk Management (TRM)
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Business Process Architect, a typical day involves analyzing and designing innovative business processes to develop comprehensive documentation that supports the implementation of new processes and technologies. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders to define detailed product requirements and use cases that align with process and functional needs. The position also includes participating in user and task analysis to accurately represent business demands, ensuring that solutions are well-tailored to organizational objectives. The role demands a thoughtful approach to process improvement and effective communication across various teams to facilitate seamless integration of new business strategies.

Roles Responsibilities:
- Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client''s business processes.
Lead end-to-end SAP TRM implementations, including Blueprinting, Configuration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
Optimize cash management, liquidity planning, bank communication, and hedge accounting.
Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization
Handle complex enhancements in TRM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client''s business requirements.
Provide guidance and support to end-users during testing, training, and post-go-live phases.


Professional Technical Skills:
Strong experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) implementation, support, and enhancement projects.
Expertise in Cash Management, Liquidity Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), Debt Investment Management, and Financial Risk Management.
Hands-on experience in managing Money Market, Foreign Exchange (FX), Securities, Loans, and Derivatives transactions.
Good understanding of treasury accounting, valuation, hedge management, and financial reporting processes.
Experience in configuration, testing, UAT, and production support activities.
Strong knowledge of integration with SAP FI, FSCM, and Bank Interfaces.
Ability to gather business requirements and prepare functional specifications.
Use AI copilots to prepare functional documents, validate configuration logic, generate test cases, and automate repetitive documentation
Awareness of AI tool limitations and responsible Agentic AI usage in finance and risk domains

The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in SAP FSCM Treasury and Risk Management (TRM).
A 15 years full time education is required.
Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance/M. Com in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience between 3 to 7 years
Must have at least 2 end-to-end implementation experience and strong hands-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In-House Cash (IHC)
Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.
Candidate should be capable to understand the existing Legacy as-is application business set up and implement in SAP all the sub-modules of SAP treasury.
Position is based out of Bengaluru - Whitefield office / client location

  • Translate strategy into delivery
  • Work closely with product, data science, and business stakeholders to turn AI objectives into executable technical roadmaps.

  • Ability to produce and communicate architecture artefacts ADRs, solution design documents to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Youll be part of the Global Business Services (GBS) Finance group in Hyderabad.
  • The team supports enterprise-wide finance operations.

  • Partner with FPA teams to understand business drivers influencing expenses, revenues, and AUM.

  • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and training materials regularly.
  • Independently manage client queries and ad-hoc requests with professionalism.
  • Identify process gaps, communicate potential delays, and proactively align stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects under supervisor guidance.
  • Design and implement AI/ML-driven solutions to enhance forecasting, anomaly detection, and variance analysis.
  • Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs) to automate reporting, commentary generation, and financial insights.
  • Integrate AI capabilities within tools such as Power BI, Alteryx, and SQL pipelines.
  • Collaborate with technology and data teams to enable data readiness for AI use cases.
  • Evaluate and recommend new AI tools and automation opportunities for FPA processes.
The experience you bring in
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and internal control frameworks.
  • Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills with a structured approach.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Power Apps and Power BI for data analysis and visualization.
  • Experience with Oracle or similar financial systems.
  • Ability to manage deliverables and meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with strong stakeholder management.
  • Highly organized, adaptable, and capable of multitasking in dynamic environments.
  • Working knowledge of Machine Learning concepts (regression, classification, clustering).
  • Experience with Python/R for data analysis and model development.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI / LLM tools
  • Experience in AI integration with BI tools
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
  • Skilled in leveraging automation and visualization tools to deliver insights.
  • Attention to detail with a disciplined, structured work style.
  • Resilient under pressure, able to deliver amid uncertainty and shifting priorities.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
  • Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Commitment to continuous learning, upskilling, and mentoring in technical domains.
  • Ability to thrive in a global, multicultural environment.
  • Strong curiosity to explore and apply emerging AI technologies in finance.
  • Ability to translate business problems into AI/analytics use cases.
  • Innovative thinking with a focus on automation-first and AI-first approaches.
Qualifications
  • Commerce graduates or MBA in Finance with development experience on technical tools.
  • FPA certification or fintech-related education is an added advantage.
  • Alteryx designer core certification is must, power bi certification is an added advantage.
  • Certification or coursework in Data Science, AI/ML, or Analytics (preferred).
  • Exposure to Python, cloud-based analytics platforms is an added advantage.
Job Details
  • Full time
  • Worker Type: Employee
  • Job Exempt: No
Workplace Model
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. Leading companies including DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson Johnson, and LiveRamp trust Nexla for mission-critical data. Named in the 2022, 2023, and 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights, headquartered in San Mateo, California.

We put our customers at the heart of everything we do, foster a data-driven mindset, take ownership of our work, and believe in the power of teamwork to achieve ambitious goals.
Role, briefly
Our Customer Success team owns the end-to-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. It is a small team, and this role does two jobs at once: running your own enterprise accounts, and leading, mentoring, and coaching the CSMs around you. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next.
Our Customer Success team owns the end-to-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next. As part of a lean and high-impact team, you will directly manage a portfolio of 10-15 strategic enterprise accounts, guiding them through both initial onboarding and long-term customer success.
What you ll own
  • Retention and expansion across your accounts. That starts at onboarding, overseeing complex implementations alongside our Solutions Engineers and Architects, including vector pipeline setup into existing customer infrastructure, and runs through renewals, upsells, and SOWs with Sales.
  • The standard of work across the CS team. Coaching and mentoring the CSMs, and owning the playbooks, health-score frameworks, and retention strategies they run on. The function has to scale as the company grows.
  • Executive relationships at your accounts. C-level sponsors, VP-level data owners, and AI steering committees, aligned on business value and ROI. You run the Executive Business Reviews and technical workshops.
  • What happens when things go wrong. You are the escalation point for critical issues, technical roadblocks, and at-risk accounts, pulling in engineering and leadership and keeping it calm.
AI tooling is part of the job here, not a side interest. Customer communication, health tracking, and account reporting are all places we expect you to use it.
Ninety days : You will have fully onboarded your initial pod of strategic enterprise accounts, audited and leveled up our CS playbooks. You will have joined key customer calls to assess health across your 10-15 enterprise accounts, identified the next set of strategic and tactical deliverables for each, and established clear coaching cadence and updated playbooks for the team.
The hard problem
Because Nexla s enterprise platform bridges deep data engineering (ETL/ELT, APIs, streaming) with cutting-edge AI architectures (agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP servers), the core tension in this role is balancing technical execution with high-level value creation.
Must-haves
  • 12+ years in customer success management, engagement management, technical delivery, professional services, or sales engineering, in B2B SaaS.
  • Background in solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical consulting where you acted as a bridge between business teams and engineering.
  • Experience establishing or scaling early-stage Customer Success frameworks (e.g., building playbook templates, health-score scoring systems, or churn-risk matrixes).
  • Track record of identifying expansion opportunities (upsells/cross-sells) and collaborating closely with Account Executives/Sales to close them.
  • You have led, mentored, or managed team members and driven team-wide KPIs.
  • You have built, negotiated, and held relationships with C-suite and senior enterprise stakeholders.
  • You have run high-stakes escalations and de-escalated risk inside complex enterprise dynamics.
  • Real technical depth in data operations and data engineering pipelines (ETL and ELT), plus modern AI paradigms: GenAI, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and LLM data flows.
  • You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.
You ll thrive here if
  • You lead from the front. You carry your own accounts while raising the standard of the people around you.
  • You challenge the status quo rather than inherit it. The playbooks here are yours to rewrite.
  • You are comfortable in a high-stakes executive conversation and in a technical one about pipeline architecture, often on the same day.
  • You can hold a lot of cross-functional threads at once and still hit the dates you committed to.
One thing to be clear about: this is a small team, so you carry accounts as well as leading. If you are looking for a pure people-management role, this is not it.

  • Hiring Manager - VP Of Customer Success - Customer Engagement, Team and culture fit
  • Lead Solutions Architect - Technical understanding
  • CRO - Revenue understanding, cross selling upselling, collaboration with Sales PreSales
  • Group Presentation - Lead a discovery, escalation or kickoff call with Stakeholders
The practical stuff
Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. Working hours: the previous version of this role required US West Coast coverage.

By joining Nexla, you aren t just entering a company; you are stepping into the critical layer of the modern data stack that powers the AI economy. We are the Data Fabric that enables industry titans like LinkedIn, DoorDash, and JJ to turn messy, siloed data into ready-to-use products for RAG and predictive models. This is your opportunity to move beyond simple tooling and build the actual infrastructure that democratizes data access for the next decade of innovation. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data engineering and own a piece of a market projected to hit billions, your career belongs here.

Marvell s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Within this ecosystem, Marvell s central advanced packaging organization plays a critical role in delivering next generation connectivity and compute products. The organization brings deep expertise in architecture, package design, and electrical performance, including SI/PI to develop advanced IC packages that support high speed interfaces. This work directly shapes product performance, reliability, and time to market, making it a key contributor to Marvell s overall technology leadership.
What You Can Expect
What You Can Expect
  • Marvell s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
  • The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.
  • Key responsibilities include developing C4 and BGA ball maps optimized for SI/PI and layout efficiency; planning and validating netlist mappings across dies, interposers, and substrates; and defining die placement, padstacks, net assignments, and package - level connectivity.
  • The engineer will create and maintain Package Requirement Documents (PRDs) detailing die arrangements, stackups, and design constraints.
What Were Looking For
What Were Looking For
  • 13-16 years of related professional experience.
  • Previous experience developing netlists and schematics for large, complex packages.
  • Previous experience developing C4 and BGA ball maps for high - pin - count designs.
  • Proficiency with design tools Cadence OrbitIO / Integrity System Planner (ISP) or equivalent
  • Strong foundational understanding of package design, including design rules, breakout, place and route, signal shielding, reference planes, power distribution, and pinout optimization across package and system requirements.
  • Solid grasp of SI/PI fundamentals at the substrate, board, and system levels; familiarity with running and interpreting signal and power simulations is a plus.
  • Knowledge of 2D, 2. 5D, and emerging packaging architectures such as CoWoS - S/R/L, EMIB, CPO, and CPC.
  • High - level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e. g. , warpage, TIM).
  • Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
  • Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across cross - functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.
  • Experience collaborating with chip and board design and electrical simulation teams to optimize package and system co - design.
  • Experience collaborating with chip and board design, and electrical simulation teams for co - design and optimization.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
This role is eligible to participate in Marvells bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the companys long-term success.
Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
Interview Integrity
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

  • Deep understanding of Feature Validation methodologies, test architecture design, coverage modelling, qualification metrics, defect escape prevention, and validation sign-off criteria.
  • Strong expertise in Windows and Linux operating system debugging.
  • Strong programming and automation skills using Python, including framework development
  • Experience building test frameworks, CI/CD-integrated validation solutions, automated reporting systems, and quality dashboards.
  • Experience with AI infrastructure platforms, GPU-attached storage environments, and large-scale datacenter storage validation is highly desirable.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, technical leadership, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated capability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple validation teams.
  • Expert planning and execution skills with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, risk mitigation, and predictable project delivery.

People Leadership & Team Performance

  • Create strong collaboration across disciplines so that customers experience one team rather than separate functional hand-offs.

  • Oversee prioritisation and escalation of complex, high-risk, or high-impact customer situations, ensuring clear ownership, timely communication, and coordinated resolution.

  • Champion the voice of the customer by ensuring recurring risks, product feedback, and service improvement opportunities are visible and acted upon.

Operational Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and maintain clear operating standards, service expectations, ownership models, escalation paths, and hand-offs across all four SSC disciplines.
  • Use customer health, product usage, engagement, support, deployment, and renewal data to understand performance, identify emerging risks, and focus team effort where it has the greatest impact.

  • Drive scalable ways of working, including standard playbooks, digital engagement, automation, self-service, and knowledge management, while preserving appropriate support for higher-risk customers.
  • Balance customer demand, team capacity, commercial priorities, and operational risk to make clear and timely resource decisions.

Retention, Renewals Commercial Partnership

One Customer Experience

jobDescription:
OCI AI Architect - J50839


Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI Architect
Location: Noida
Brief Description
We are looking for an experienced OCI AI Architect to lead the design, architecture and deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and traditional AI/ML solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
This role requires a deep understanding of OCI Architecture, Large Language Models, Agentic and AI/ML frameworks, data engineering, and OCI-native services
The ideal candidate will drive Agentic AI transformation initiatives, architect scalable AI solutions over OCI, and enable intelligent automation that can seamlessly integrate within the operational workflows of Oracle ERP and finance systems.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, Architect and deploy enterprise grade AI/ML and Gen AI solutions using AI Capabilities over OCI platform.
• Architect and implement agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, including multi-agent orchestration and workflow automation.
• Design & implement RAG pipelines, leveraging embeddings, vector search, and enterprise knowledge bases using Oracle Autonomous Database (including 23ai vector capabilities).
• Build and lead development of ML pipelines and LLM fine-tuning pipelines, including parameter-efficient tuning (PEFT) and domain adaptation.
• Architect end-to-end AI solution lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, & feedback loops.
• Define and implement AI governance, responsible AI, and security guardrails, ensuring compliance with enterprise standards.
• Design secure AI deployments using OCI networking, IAM, private endpoints, and data security best practices.
• Provide technical guidance and best practices around MLOps, model versioning, deployment automation, and AI governance.
• Evaluate and adopt emerging AI ecosystem standards (e.g., MCP) to enable scalable and interoperable agentic architectures.
• Evaluating and monitoring LLM outputs, including hallucination detection, response quality scoring, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
• Architect cost-optimized AI solutions by selecting appropriate models, optimizing token usage, and designing efficient inference strategies.
• Design memory strategies for agentic systems, including short-term context, long-term memory, and knowledge persistence.
• Design human-in-the-loop workflows for validation, exception handling, and continuous learning in AI systems.
• Understanding of event-driven and microservices-based architectures for scalable AI systems.
• Define testing strategies for AI systems, including prompt testing, scenario validation, and regression testing.
• Support customer presentations & solution demos, as needed with architectural insights and technical credibility.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, and application teams to identify AI opportunities and deliver AI-first, cloud-native solutions
Skills Required
• 1015 years in Oracle Cloud and AI, with 5+ years of proven and hands-on experience in designing, architecting and deploying AI/ML & Gen AI Solution over OCI AI stack.
• Strong Python programming skills and experience with data processing (JSON, APIs, etc.)
• Strong hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g. Cohere, GPT etc.) & advanced prompt engineering techniques (e.g. Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct).
• Proven experience designing RAG architecture, embeddings-based retrieval, and vector search systems
• Strong understanding Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning.
• Strong expertise in Agentic AI frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph) and multi-agent orchestration patterns
• Working experience with at least 2 OCI Pre-Built AI Services: Vision, Speech, Language, Anomaly Detection, Document Understanding etc.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and architecture principles: data lifecycle, feature stores, model registries, inference serving, feedback loops
• Must have working experience with semantic matching, fuzzy logic, and similarity scoring algorithms (e.g., cosine similarity, Jaccard, Levenshtein distance)
• Strong knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI.
• Must have knowledge of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Proficient in AI/ML/Gen AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain) & Vector DBs (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus).
• Proficient in Agentic AI Frameworks (e.g. CrewAI, AutoGen and multi-agent orchestration workflow)
• Working knowledge with OCI Data Science, OCI Gen AI Service, OCI Gen AI Agents, Oracle ATP, Data Flow (Apache Spark), OCI Functions, API Gateway, and Monitoring
• Must have experience working with Oracle ATP, 23ai Databases and vector queries
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Good to have experience in front end programming languages such as React, Angular or Javascript etc.
• Good to have: Experience with Finance domain solutions.
• Good to Understand Oracle Cloud Deployment, architecture, networking, Security and other essential components
• Good to have: Understanding of emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enabling interoperability between LLMs, tools, and enterprise systems.
Qualifications:
• B.Tech – Computer Science / MCA or equivalent degrees
• Any degree or diploma in AI would be preferred.
• Preferred: Two or more OCI certifications such as: OCI Generative AI Professional, Oracle AI Vector Search Professional, OCI Data Science Professional, OCI Architect Professional.
• Good to have AI Certifications from the following: Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications Developers, Oracle APEX Developer Professional.

Cvent is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Architect to spearhead the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions across our product suite. This is an exciting opportunity to lead the charge in bringing cutting-edge AI technologies to the event industry, enhancing our platforms with capabilities that drive innovation and efficiency. With over 15 years of experience in diverse technologies, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing AI-driven systems that align with Cvents architectural vision and strategic goals.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of AI solutions across our enterprise SaaS platforms, leveraging expertise in large language models (LLMs), agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing and new products, ensuring scalability, reliability, and high performance of AI-driven features.
  • Provide technical oversight and conduct thorough analysis of AI-related requirements, ensuring optimal architectural quality and alignment with Cvents paved road.
  • Collaborate with product, UI/UX, and project management teams to define AI solutions that meet business objectives and enhance user experience.
  • Document and deliver training on AI systems, promoting re-use of AI tools and technology across the company.
  • Engage with 3rd party vendors to negotiate AI features and pricing, ensuring favorable terms for Cvent.
  • Contribute to the automation needed for continuous deployment of AI solutions, and build tools that enhance developer productivity.
  • Act as a key contributor in defining AI best practices and standards, while providing technical guidance across various departments.

What You Will Need for this Position:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 11+ years of experience in software development with a strong background in AI technologies, including LLMs, agents, RAG systems, and eval frameworks.
  • Proven experience with AWS, CDK/CloudFormation, TypeScript, and Java.
  • Strong coding and development skills with a broad understanding of technology, including algorithms, data structures, persistence technologies, and networks.
  • Exceptional technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI systems to diverse audiences.
  • A track record of leading by example, solving complex problems, and providing mentorship to junior developers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AI platforms within an enterprise setting.
  • Familiarity with cloud strategy and AI architecture, particularly on AWS.
  • Ability to make strategic technology decisions with a long-term vision (4-10 years),specifically in AI domains.
  • Experience in conducting due diligence and technical integration for AI-related mergers and acquisitions.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and gain support for AI ideas and solutions across the organization.
  • Experience presenting at company-wide meetings and external conferences, serving as a technology figurehead for AI initiatives.

About Pump Academy Private Limited

Pump Academy Private Limited (PAPL) is building iPUMPNET India's most advanced Industrial IIoT platform for intelligent monitoring, optimization, and predictive analytics of pumping infrastructure across water utilities, wastewater systems, and large industrial facilities.

iPUMPNET is a full-stack IIoT solution that spans field instrumentation, industrial data acquisition hardware, edge gateways, cloud data platforms, AI/ML analytics, and command-centre visualization. The platform is deployed at scale across major utilities including BWSSB and BMC pumping stations, and is set for exponential national and international growth.

PAPL's technology organization includes four specialized departments: AI/ML, Hardware & Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, and IT Infrastructure & Platform Operations all collaborating to deliver a best-in-class industrial intelligence platform.

We are at an inflection point: transitioning the iPUMPNET platform to a robust, cloud-native SaaS architecture capable of serving hundreds of utilities and industrial customers and we need a world-class Enterprise Architect to lead this transformation.


The Role

This is a rare opportunity to be the founding architecture voice of a fast-growing industrial technology company. As Enterprise Architect, you will own the end-to-end technical vision for migrating and scaling the iPUMPNET platform to a cloud-native, data-intensive, AI-powered SaaS product. You will work directly with PAPL's leadership and cross-functional technology teams to define the architecture blueprint that will take iPUMPNET from a high-performing on-premise/hybrid deployment to one of the world's leading IIoT platforms for pumping infrastructure.

This role demands deep expertise in cloud architecture, industrial IoT systems, data platform design, artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep analytics, data visualization and a strategic mindset to help PAPL scale its business to the next order of magnitude. You will set standards, govern technical decisions, align architecture to business outcomes, and actively mentor engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution

Define and own the comprehensive cloud migration roadmap for the iPUMPNET platform — from current hybrid/on-premise deployments to a fully cloud-native architecture.

Architect a multi-tenant SaaS platform capable of supporting cloud deployments, enterprise LAN deployments, and edge-to-cloud hybrid models.

Scale and govern the Azure cloud platform aligned to iPUMPNET's industrial data requirements, AI/ML workloads, and partner ecosystem.

Establish reference architectures for cloud onboarding of new utilities and industrial customers with standardized, automated provisioning.

2. IIoT Platform Architecture

Design the end-to-end platform architecture spanning the full iPUMPNET technology stack:

– Field sensors, SCADA, and industrial data acquisition hardware

– Edge gateway processing and AI-enabled edge analytics

– Industrial data ingestion pipelines and communication layers (MQTT, Modbus, REST, RS-485)

– Cloud data platform, time-series databases, and data lake architecture

– AI/ML analytics engine, digital twin infrastructure, and predictive models

– Web dashboards and command-centre visualization

Define integration standards between hardware, firmware, software, and cloud layers across PAPL's four technology departments.

Architect a scalable data lake and time-series data management platform for AI/ML model training, predictive maintenance, pump scheduling optimization, and energy analytics.

3. Deep Analytics & AI/ML Architecture

Design the data architecture required to support advanced analytics, including pump efficiency analysis, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, energy optimization, and digital twin simulation.

Define the data engineering pipeline architecture for ingesting, processing, and curating large-scale, real-time industrial data from hundreds of pumping stations.

Collaborate with the AI/ML team to architect model deployment pipelines, AIOps/MLOps infrastructure, and model versioning systems on cloud.

Collaborate with the Software Engineering team to develop and deploy best practices and industry standards around DevOps, DevSecOps

Architect the digital twin infrastructure aligned to Bentley iTwin and related simulation technologies.

4. Enterprise Architecture Governance

Establish and maintain an enterprise architecture framework aligned to industry best practices (TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent).

Define architecture principles, design patterns, standards, and guardrails across all technology departments.

Lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) and govern all major technical decisions across software, AI/ML, hardware integration, and infrastructure.

Evaluate and recommend third-party platforms, tools, and technology partners including analytics platforms, vibration analytics systems, and predictive analytics tools.

Drive technology standardization to enable automated, scalable onboarding of new customers via sensor templates and standardized data schemas.

5. Scalability, Security & Reliability

Architect for extreme scale — designing systems capable of ingesting and processing real-time data from hundreds to thousands of pumping stations globally.

Define cybersecurity architecture for industrial IoT environments, addressing device security, data encryption, network segmentation, and cloud access controls.

Design high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures for mission-critical pumping infrastructure monitoring.

Establish disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity architecture.

Aware of PAPL’s ISO-aligned management systems: Quality Management System (QMS – ISO 9001), Environmental Management System (EMS – ISO 14001), Information Security Management System (ISMS – ISO 27001), and Occupational Health & Safety Management System (OHSMS – ISO 45001).

6. Business Growth & Technology Strategy

Act as a senior technology thought leader, contributing directly to PAPL's product strategy, investor narratives, and technology roadmap.

Identify architectural enablers for new revenue streams, new geographies, and new customer segments.

Contribute to patent applications, technical research, industry conferences, and PAPL's positioning as an IIoT innovation leader.

Assess and advise on standards compliance including ISO and CMMI frameworks.

7. Team Leadership & Mentoring

Collaborate deeply with the heads of AI/ML, Hardware & Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, and IT Infrastructure departments.

Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, elevating architecture maturity across PAPL's technology organization.

Translate complex architecture decisions into clear, actionable guidance for engineering teams.


Required Qualifications & Experience

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Azure/AWS/ GCP Solutions Architect certification is a must. TOGAF certification (Foundation or Practitioner) strongly preferred.

Experience

15+ years of technology experience, with at least 8 years in Enterprise Architecture or Principal/Distinguished Engineer roles.

Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering cloud migration programs at scale — preferably migrating industrial, operational technology (OT), or data-intensive platforms.

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS (preferred), Microsoft Azure, or GCP — including IaaS, PaaS, serverless, and managed data services.

Deep understanding of Industrial IoT (IIoT) architectures, including edge-to-cloud data flows, industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, RS-485, OPC-UA), and SCADA integrations.

Strong experience with data platform architecture — data lakes, time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, Azure Data Explorer, or similar), streaming data (Kafka, Azure Event Hubs), and data warehousing.

Experience designing architectures for AI/ML platforms including MLOps pipelines, model deployment infrastructure, and real-time inference systems.

Strong background in SaaS platform architecture — multi-tenancy, API design, microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

Experience in cybersecurity architecture for OT/IIoT environments — a significant advantage.

Technical Skills

Cloud Platforms: AWS (preferred), Azure, GCP

IIoT Protocols & Standards: MQTT, Modbus, RS-485, OPC-UA, REST/JSON, HTTP

Data Architecture: Data lakes, time-series databases, streaming data pipelines, data warehousing

AI/ML Infrastructure: MLOps, model deployment, feature stores, digital twin platforms

Application Architecture: Microservices, API-first design, serverless, containerization

Security: Zero-trust, OT/IIoT cybersecurity, identity & access management

DevOps & Automation: CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep)

Backend Technologies: Familiarity with ASP.NET/C#, Python, SQL and time-series databases

Soft Skills & Mindset

Systems thinker with the ability to connect hardware, software, data, and business strategy into a unified architecture vision.

Exceptional communication skills — able to present complex architectures to executive leadership, engineering teams, and external stakeholders.

Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving startup environments, and building from the ground up.

Collaborative leader with the ability to influence without authority across cross-functional teams.

Strong bias for outcomes — architecture decisions must deliver measurable business impact.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you will have deeply understood iPUMPNET's current architecture, identified the top architectural risks and opportunities, and published a Cloud Migration Architecture Blueprint with a phased roadmap. In your first 9 months, the platform will be live on a cloud-native SaaS architecture, with the first cohort of new utilities onboarded through automated provisioning. Within 18 months, iPUMPNET will be recognized as a best-in-class IIoT SaaS platform, with deep analytics capabilities powering insights for hundreds of pumping stations — and you will have been instrumental in making that happen.


What We Offer

A unique opportunity to architect one of India's most innovative Industrial IIoT platforms from the ground up.

Direct access to PAPL's leadership and genuine influence over the company's technology direction and business growth.

A collaborative, multi-disciplinary technology organization spanning AI/ML, hardware, embedded systems, software, and infrastructure.

Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

The chance to work on real-world deployments impacting water utilities, wastewater systems, and industrial facilities — systems that matter.

Real-World Impact: You aren't just building another SaaS tool; you are solving the global water crisis by making pumping systems smarter and more efficient.

Green-Tech Innovation: Lead the charge in reducing the carbon footprint of massive industrial utilities through AI-driven energy saving.

End-to-End Ownership: From the sensor on the pipe to the insight on the CEO’s mobile app, you own the entire value chain.

A culture that values innovation, research, patents, and continuous learning.

Role Overview



As a Lead Developer, you will own and evolve the core platform services that power our AI-driven products. You will design and build production-grade APIs, LLM-based extraction and enrichment pipelines, and agentic workflows ensuring they are reliable, performant, and scalable. You will work closely with AI engineers, front-end developers, and product stakeholders to translate investment use cases into robust back-end solutions.



This role is ideal for an engineer who combines deep Python expertise with hands-on experience building LLM-driven applications and who thrives in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment.



Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving both internal and external consumers.
  • Build and optimise LLM-based pipelines for information extraction, summarisation, and classification across diverse source types.
  • Develop and maintain agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, including tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning chains, and feedback loops.
  • Extend and operate the MCP server layer (FastMCP), enabling seamless integration of AI capabilities into third-party tools and workflows.
  • Design and maintain data models and query patterns in MongoDB Atlas, leveraging both its document database and vector store capabilities for RAG pipelines.
  • Build and manage data processing and scheduling pipelines using Apache Airflow, deployed on AWS EKS.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts and ensure efficient data flows.
  • Implement robust testing strategies (unit, integration, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for reliable, automated deployments.
  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and architectural discussions, contributing to a culture of engineering excellence.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system reliability and performance across the platform.


Experience


  • Years of Experience: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on Python back-end development.
  • LLM & AI Development: At least 1 year of hands-on experience building LLM-based applications, including one or more of: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-based systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph), LLM-driven data extraction, or prompt engineering.
  • Python Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python, including modern async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Strong understanding of Python packaging, dependency management, and best practices.
  • Database Skills: Experience with MongoDB or similar document databases. Familiarity with vector stores and embedding-based search is highly desirable.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Practical experience with AWS services, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS), and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
  • API Design: Proven ability to design, build, and document RESTful APIs that are clean, versioned, and production-ready.
  • Software Engineering Practices: Strong grasp of version control (Git), testing frameworks (pytest, etc.), CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with FastMCP or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Background in processing unstructured data from diverse sources (PDFs, audio, messaging platforms).
  • Understanding of capital markets, investment research workflows, or financial data.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
